# Source histories constrain retained-content binding

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every type of histories, dates, relations, probes and reports: the actual history always fits its dated records, and a history fits them exactly when it gives the same records; every explanation of an earlier packet by a family history fitting the records and an admitted source gives the actual content exactly when every family rival giving the same packet with another content is told apart by some dated control; where the family holds the actual history, an agreed reading is the actual one. Over dates, where the relation takes two values, controls at both ends of a span that read the same settle every date between exactly when at most one change is admitted or no date lies strictly between, and a change seen at both ends is not located. The four-moment source histories are instances: under actual-history and disturbance coverage, route candidates at each retained packet's date supply unique-binding correctness without global route stability; in the one-change envelope, agreeing prior and following controls settle naming, so later deterioration and improvement are read right, while a late control alone, controls only before and after, and an omitted temporary change (read wrongly outside the family, left open inside the two-change family) are the law's failing side.

Canonical source: [HistoricalBinding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/inquiry-root/HistoricalBinding.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Source identity, four-moment ordering, form recognition, atomic operations, decoding and faithful controls are available; route family and change/disturbance envelopes are supplied.
- General correctness requires the actual history in the candidate family, target in the available repertoire, and each relevant packet realizing that target with an admitted disturbance. The actual history and change point are not learner inputs.
- Successful witnesses use at most one route change and a known common packet disturbance; these are not facts learned from the data.

Reporting relations change while old contents persist; later evidence changes their historical interpretation. Controlled probes are not equivalent to children’s familiar naming, and present trust adjustment does not identify retrospective reinterpretation. Developmental and comparative primary evidence requires distinguishing acquired access sensitivity, source/order retention and task-specific use; one successful response does not validate every interface.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 checked 10 new theorems / 36 declarations; 304 inherited theorems / 549 declarations rebuilt separately. New audits: 25 empty, 11 propext and Quot.sound; inherited closure contains Classical.choice. Primary comparison and author counterreview; no empirical reanalysis or independent-agent acceptance. This addition assesses methods, results and relevant discussion in five primary papers, with no new mathematics or empirical reanalysis; original Lean receipts remain unchanged. General laws: checker receipts bound.

Does not form developmental identity/time retention or persistence assumptions, prove arbitrary-length histories, provide a complete cost account, or identify neural mechanisms, consciousness or evolutionary origins. General filtering is not a new invention of this project. Cross-study task differences do not identify the causal moderator of transfer, and nonhuman performance does not establish homology or adaptation.

- Unlocated change or unknown disturbance preserves uncertainty; an omitted temporary change produces a wrong old binding, while widening the change family restores uncertainty.
